description: Get the full nutrition panel of one dish. Name matched case-insensitively; exact match wins, else unique substring. Dish row uses the same coded layout as the sweep tools. Panel values are numbers with one units map; micronutrient amount is the derived amount, with the published percent behind it. asOf data age. Allergens advisory. Use this only when you need the full panel for a single dish. For multiple dishes, use filter_dishes with include_nutrients instead.
